description: This file is a Java source file defining an Android activity (BitmapPixels) that demonstrates bitmap pixel manipulation and rendering within an Android application. It includes a nested View class (SampleView) that creates and displays bitmaps with different configurations.

classes.name: BitmapPixels
classes.description: Main activity class that sets up the activity and hosts the custom view for bitmap pixel demonstration.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity and sets the content view to an instance of SampleView.

classes.name: SampleView
classes.description: A custom View subclass that creates and displays three different bitmaps with various pixel formats demonstrating pixel manipulation.

methods.name: SampleView
methods.description: Constructor that initializes three bitmaps with gradient data.

methods.name: onDraw
methods.description: Overrides the drawing method to render the three created bitmaps on the canvas.

methods.name: getR32
methods.description: Extracts the red component from a premultiplied color integer.

methods.name: getG32
methods.description: Extracts the green component from a premultiplied color integer.

methods.name: getB32
methods.description: Extracts the blue component from a premultiplied color integer.

methods.name: getA32
methods.description: Extracts the alpha component from a premultiplied color integer.

methods.name: pack8888
methods.description: Packs individual RGBA components into a single 32-bit integer in ARGB order.

methods.name: pack565
methods.description: Packs RGB components into a 16-bit RGB565 format.

methods.name: pack4444
methods.description: Packs RGBA components into a 16-bit ARGB4444 format.

methods.name: mul255
methods.description: Multiplies a color component by alpha, with proper rounding.

methods.name: premultiplyColor
methods.description: Converts a color into a premultiplied ARGB format.

methods.name: makeRamp
methods.description: Generates ramp data for different pixel formats between two colors.

methods.name: makeBuffer
methods.description: Creates and fills an IntBuffer or ShortBuffer with pixel data.
